# xwidget-fields — every field a widget declaration takes (generated)

> Straight from the editor's `.xwidget` contract: every field, where it is edited, and what it does. Rules and idioms live in `numable docs xwidget`; a field that is not listed here does nothing and reports nothing.

| Field | Required | Edited in | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | yes | the canvas workspace | File format version — always 2 |
| `title` | yes | the widget form | The widget's name, shown on the dashboard, in the add-widget panel and in the home-screen widget list |
| `sub` | — | the widget form | Subtitle |
| `layout` | yes | the widget form | Size code: tens digit = columns, ones digit = rows (22 is two by two) |
| `i18n` | — | the "Edit translations" entry | Language overrides for title/sub (B table); params are data and are not localized |
| `params` | — | the widget form | Instance parameters — what lets the same widget be added twice and watch two different things. Scalars only |
| `events.onClick` | — | the widget form | Whole-widget tap Tapping the widget on the home screen opens the app and replays this binding; both forms (nav string and action flow) work there. |
| `events.onEdit` | — | the widget form | Long-press "Edit parameters" · optional With an action flow: collect the value via singleValue / xform, then write it back with widget.updateParams. With a route: html / xpage / form page types all work. |
| `jobs` | — | the widget form | Which alerts a long-press on this widget can create — rules from this package's xJob/, pre-filled by mapping the widget's parameters in Each entry is { id, params }. `id` is the file name of xJob/<id>.xjob in this package; `params` maps widget instance parameters onto alert parameters (values may only be ${widgetParam} or a literal — fetch output is a result, not an identity, and does not exist at the moment of the long press). Without a declaration, "Add alert" never appears. |
| `canvas.source` | yes | the canvas workspace | What this widget looks like — points at a .rcn |
| `canvas.depends` | — | the canvas workspace | Where this widget's data comes from — one or more data-flow bindings |
| `canvas.refresh.interval` | — | the canvas workspace | Window HH:MM-HH:MM@seconds or raw seconds |
| `canvas.refresh.at` | — | the canvas workspace | Daily time point HH:MM |
| `canvas.refresh.tz` | — | the canvas workspace | IANA timezone |
| `canvas.onEdit` | — | **has no effect** | Has no effect here — no platform reads it. Long-press editing hangs off the top-level events.onEdit |

> "Edited in" refers to where it lives in the desktop editor; when you write the file by hand it only tells you which level of the file the key belongs to.
